title: Caesar Cipher
prompt: Implement Caesar cipher encrypt(text, shift) and decrypt(text, shift). Shift letters by N positions wrapping within a-z and A-Z separately; preserve case; leave non-letters unchanged. Shifts may be negative or larger than 26 (normalize mod 26). decrypt(text, shift) equals encrypt(text, -shift).
acceptance: round-trip: decrypt(encrypt(s, k), k) == s for sample strings
